frameworks.name: 10-Stage Business Roadmap
frameworks.definition: A ten-stage progression from zero to $100M+ revenue that applies across software, physical products, service businesses, and brick-and-mortar; each stage has distinct constraint symptoms and graduation requirements across eight business functions.

claims.text: The fastest way to become the person you want to be is to put yourself in a situation where you have no choice but to become them. When options are removed, endurance becomes possible—humans will endure constraints they believe are unavoidable.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
conditions: The situation must force behavioral adaptation
claims.mechanism: Removal of choice eliminates the internal debate that precedes avoidance; survival instinct drives adaptation.
bounded_by: Does not apply when escape routes exist or appear viable

claims.text: Constraints create the innovation required to escape the constraint. Historical human achievements emerged from necessity—when the only choice was to endure or perish, people endured and innovated.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: Scarcity forces prioritization and creative problem-solving; abundant resources allow complacency.
bounded_by: Does not apply to artificial or self-imposed constraints
Does not apply when resources are plentiful enough to sidestep the bottleneck

claims.text: Alex Hormozi completed the 10-stage business roadmap (zero to $100M+) multiple times across software, physical products, service businesses, and brick-and-mortar. Fewer than 1% of companies finish all stages.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi

numbers.axis: Percentage of companies completing the 10-stage roadmap

examples.text: Alex Hormozi signed his first gym lease with $5,000 in his bank account. The monthly rent was $5,000. He had never consistently earned significant income before, and realized that 100% of his previous job salary would pay rent but leave nothing for food or other expenses. This forced choice—commit with no financial buffer—created urgency to build a sustainable business model.

practices.text: When starting a business, one of the key instructions to give new owners is: learn to endure. Build your capacity to handle constraints and difficulty as a foundational skill before scaling.
Diagnose constraint symptoms across eight business functions at each revenue stage to identify the true bottleneck blocking graduation to the next stage.
